primary_authority.title: Resonant Induced Orbital Electron Capture: Novel method for low-energy anti-nu_e detection
primary_record_observations: RIOEC is resonant and requires the antineutrino energy to match the atomic/nuclear energy difference.
For continuous-spectrum sources the effective cross section depends on the spectral intensity of the anti-nu_e flux at resonance rather than on neutrino energy alone.

secondary_cross_check_not_used_as_author.observation: A secondary review displays a Breit-Wigner form sigma = [B0 Gamma/(2 pi)]/[(E-E_R)^2+Gamma^2/4] and a continuous-source relation proportional to B0 S(E_R).
secondary_cross_check_not_used_as_author.policy: Not accepted to fill the primary normalization package because the frozen 0068 contract explicitly forbids secondary-source substitution for missing factors.

scientific_guard: No Cu63 RIOEC event rate or W/kg is computed in 0068. Missing primary normalization factors are not guessed, imported from secondary summaries, or inferred post hoc from candidate tables.
